jobs.title: Senior Manager, DC Safety
jobs.description_text: WHY JOIN ALO? Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life. OVERVIEW: The Senior Manager, Safety is responsible for leading the execution and advancement of safety strategy across Alo’s distribution center network. This role provides leadership and oversight for safety programs, processes, performance, and safety teams while partnering closely with distribution center and cross-functional leadership. The Senior Manager balances strategic program development with hands-on field leadership to establish consistent standards, mitigate operational risk, strengthen safety ownership, and build scalable systems that support Alo’s continued growth. RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead the execution of Alo’s safety strategy across the distribution center network, ensuring consistent standards and practices while accounting for site-specific operational needs. Partner with the Director of Safety & Operations Training to develop, implement, and continuously improve scalable safety programs, standards, processes, and systems. jobs.title: Manager SAP EWM – Logistics / Supply Chain (m/w/d)
jobs.description_text: What you can expect from us As the business-side EWM project lead, you take overall responsibility in our client projects for the planning, management and successful implementation of our SAP EWM initiatives from a Logistics perspective. You ensure that our clients’ operational requirements define the framework for the solution. To achieve this, you define functional objectives together with the client, set priorities and steer internal IT, external SAP consultants and other service providers so that robust, practical and sustainable solutions are delivered. You act as the central interface between Logistics, IT and implementation partners and represent our clients’ business interests clearly and consistently. Your Responsibilities You are responsible for the overall functional management of SAP EWM projects for our clients, including implementation, roll-out, optimization and, where applicable, migration from SAP WM to SAP EWM, from a Logistics / Supply Chain perspective. Together with our clients, you define the functional objectives, requirements and success criteria for warehouse and intralogistics processes and ensure that these are implemented consistently by IT and implementation partners. You coordinate and lead functional key users, process owners and, where applicable, internal EWM experts on the client side and support the development of a strong and reliable business team around EWM. You manage external SAP implementation partners, developers and technical service
